UNITED STATES AIR FORCE

Appellee )
)
v. )
) ORDER
Nicholas J. SCOTT )

U.S. Air Force )
Appellant ) Panel 2
On 17 August 2026, Appellant moved to withdraw his case from appellate
review and attach his DD Form 2330, Waiver/Withdrawal of Appellate Rights
in General and Special Courts-Martial Subject to Review by a Court of Crimi-
nal Appeals, signed by Appellant on 2 August 2026 and Appellant’s counsel on
7 August 2026.
Accordingly, it is by the court on this 20th day of August, 2026,
ORDERED:
Appellant’s Motion to Withdraw from Appellate Review and Motion to At-
tach is GRANTED. Appellant’s case is forwarded to the Appellate Records
Branch (JAJM) for further processing in accordance with Rules for Courts-
Martial 1115(f)(3) and 1201, Manual for Courts-Martial, United States (2024
ed.).
FOR THE COURT
JACOB B. HOEFERKAMP, Capt, USAF
Chief Commissioner
